parameters.jsCode: const items = $input.all(); return items.map(item => { const resumeKey = Object.keys(item.json).find(key => key.trim() === "Resume (PDF)" ); const resumeUrl = resumeKey ? String(item.json[resumeKey]).trim() : ""; let fileId = null; if (resumeUrl) { const match = resumeUrl.match(/[-\w]{25,}/); if (match) { fileId = match[0]; } } return { json: { ...item.json, resumeKey, resumeUrl, fileId, }, }; });

const items = $input.all(); const candidateItems = $('Create Candidate Object').all(); return items.map((item, index) => { let text = item.json.text || item.json.output || item.json.response || ""; text = text.replace(/```json\n?/g, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim(); let parsed; try { parsed = JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { parsed = { parseError: true, rawText: text }; } const candidate = candidateItems[index].json.candidate; return { json: { ...parsed, candidateName: candidate.name, candidateEmail: candidate.email, candidatePhone: candidate.phone, position: candidate.position } }; });

parameters.text:
=={{
`You are an expert Technical Recruiter and Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

Your task is to analyze a candidate's resume and extract structured information.

IMPORTANT RULES:
- Return ONLY valid JSON.
- Do NOT wrap the response in markdown.
- Do NOT explain your reasoning.
- Do NOT include any text before or after the JSON.
- If information is missing, return an empty string "", an empty array [], or 0.
- Never invent information that does not appear in the resume.
- Normalize skills (for example: "JS" becomes "JavaScript").

Candidate Details

Name:
${$json.candidate.name}

Email:
${$json.candidate.email}

Phone:
${$json.candidate.phone}

Position Applied:
${$json.candidate.position}

Experience Selected:
${$json.candidate.experience}

Location:
${$json.candidate.location}

LinkedIn:
${$json.candidate.linkedin}

GitHub:
${$json.candidate.github}

Resume Text:

 Resume Text: ${$json.resume}

Return EXACTLY this JSON structure:

{
  "candidateName": "",
  "email": "",
  "phone": "",
  "position": "",
  "location": "",
  "summary": "",
  "skills": [],
  "programmingLanguages": [],
  "frameworks": [],
  "databases": [],
  "cloudPlatforms": [],
  "tools": [],
  "education": "",
  "certifications": [],
  "yearsExperience": 0,
  "projects": [],
  "strengths": [],
  "weaknesses": []
}`
}}
